this study has demonstrated a significant prevalence of dyslipidemia in patients over two-years on first-line ART.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the lipid profile of HIV-patients is influenced by the duration on ART, smoking and alcohol consumption.
the prevalence of dyslipidemia was very high and was associated with the duration of treatment, smoking, and the presence of metabolic disease in our study population in Cameroon.
the study demonstrated a high prevalence and incidence of lipid abnormalities in patients on first line ART.

the lipid profile of HIV patients receiving ART in Cameroon is similar to those of patients in developed countries and therefore should be monitored in the same way.
